title: UMH Convergence Gap Ledger Record
description: One gap from the convergence audit's unified gap ledger (270 gap candidates across 17 workstream ledgers; severity distribution at audit time: 23 critical / 87 high / 112 medium / 48 low). IDs follow GAP-<workstream>-<NNN> as emitted by the workstream ledgers (e.g. GAP-A-004, GAP-B1-009, GAP-E1-003). Each gap states current vs desired state with path:line evidence and links to the work packet that closes it.

id.description: Gap id in the ledger namespace, e.g. GAP-B1-009.

severity.description: Audit severity. critical = broken source of truth, ungoverned mutation path, or identity/trust-boundary failure; high = contract violation or fragmentation with active drift; medium = contained fragmentation, stale enforcement, or coverage hole; low = hygiene/dormant-classification issue.

area.description: Free-text concern area as recorded in the ledger (e.g. 'entrypoint authority / source of truth', 'type contract', 'policy engine coverage', 'layer contract integrity').

workstream.description: Source workstream ledger that raised the gap.

current_state.description: Observed state constituting the gap, with concrete detail.

desired_state.description: Target state once the gap is closed.

evidence.description: path:line citations (and/or command outputs) backing the gap, e.g. 'substrate/control_plane/runtime/cognitive_loop.py:365' or 'check_type_divergence.py --all exit 1'.

closed_by_work_packet.description: Work packet id that closes this gap (see work_packet.schema.json); null while unassigned.

layer.description: Optional four-layer ontology assignment of the gap's owner concern.
